findings.description: WH says the renewed closet concealment lasted from discovery of the incident until corpse removal.

contexts.japanese: 事件に気付いた関係者が、秀吉の遺体を運び出すまでの間、再び夏妃はクローゼット内に潜伏。
contexts.japanesePC: 事件に気付いた関係者が、秀吉の遺体を運び出すまでの間、再び夏妃はクローゼット内に潜伏。
contexts.japanesePS3: 事件に気付いた関係者が、秀吉の遺体を運び出すまでの間、再び夏妃はクローゼット内に潜伏。
contexts.WH: From the time the others became aware of the incident to the time that they carried Hideyoshi's corpse out, Natsuhi once again concealed herself in the closet.
contexts.MG: Natsuhi once again concealed herself in the closet from the time the others became aware of the incident to the time that they carried out Hideyoshi's body.
contexts.UP: Natsuhi once again concealed herself in the closet from the time the others became aware of the incident to the time that they carried out Hideyoshi's body.
contexts.note: Complete documented1–130 review; parent verified4–5/86 and PC57637–57638/57967–57970. Same revised wording independently evaluated in MG/UP without asserting one is downstream of the other. Sexual accusations present current JP, no yellow.

findings.sourceReading: 事件に気付いた関係者が、秀吉の遺体を運び出すまでの間 sets the endpoint by the people who noticed the crime carrying out the corpse; it does not set the concealment’s start to their discovery.
findings.alternative: Hiding necessarily spans discovery and removal, but WH’s from-the-time wording adds a specific onset where the source describes waiting until removal after the murder.

The MangaGamer and PS3 witnesses are not independently certified retail extractions.

findings.description: Natsuhi instruction to relay the following message becomes a request to tell her.

contexts.japanesePC: 「.........なら伝えなさい...！　これで気は晴れましたか？　１９年間、あなたを苛んだ痛みと苦しみは、少しは癒えましたか...？！
contexts.WH: ".........Then tell me...!  Are you happy now?  Has a bit of that pain and suffering you've endured for 19 years gone away...?!
contexts.note: Full documented111–250 review; parent checked153–156/212–215. Hold UP155 nurse as broad caring/holding sense in adoption context; no breastfeeding fact asserted. Hold MG214 reasons for presence as implicit undisclosable origins with existence suppressed215. UP236–238 duration relocation spans same nineteen-year rhetorical window. No proven yellow or additional firm finding.

findings.sourceReading: なら伝えなさい directs the alleged present underling to transmit her ensuing questions to the absent man.
findings.alternative: The subsequent questions still address the man directly, but tell me reverses communication direction.

findings.description: MG and UP change financial subjugation of the birth family into financial ruin.

contexts.japanese:
夏妃は、右代宮家がかつて、実家を経済的に屈服させたことへも復讐するため、
右代宮家の財産の乗っ取りを画策しました。
contexts.japanesePS3:
夏妃は、右代宮家がかつて、実家を経済的に屈服させたことへも復讐するため、
右代宮家の財産の乗っ取りを画策しました。
contexts.MG:
As revenge for financially ruining her birth family,
Natsuhi also plotted to take over the Ushiromiya family's fortune.
contexts.UP:
As revenge for financially ruining her birth family,

findings.sourceReading: 経済的に屈服させた denotes forced financial submission. PC57637–57638 correctly preserves submission; both re-edits use financially ruining.
findings.alternative: Ruin can figuratively mean economically crushing a family, without bankruptcy. It nonetheless loses imposed financial submission as the stated revenge motive.
